steps.en: Officer sees the saved address on the notice
steps.id: Officer melihat alamat tersimpan di notice
steps.why_en: The view is the general notice page, not a Letter of Advice screen.
steps.why_id: Tampilannya halaman notice umum, bukan layar Letter of Advice.

steps.en: Officer confirms the decision to send a Letter of Advice
steps.id: Officer mengonfirmasi keputusan kirim Letter of Advice
steps.why_en: Only a text label exists; no confirm action is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada label teks; aksi konfirmasi tidak dibangun.

steps.en: Defendant and notice are added to the Letter of Advice batch
steps.id: Defendant dan notice masuk ke batch Letter of Advice
steps.why_en: No batch for Letter of Advice exists anywhere.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada batch Letter of Advice di mana pun.
